title: The daemon serves the preview receipt and its captured screenshot bytes over authenticated read routes
description:
LEAF ROW filed by architect-b63fabf3 on 2026-09-06 at governor-afbde490's 14:44Z direction (option (b) of the waiver). Consumer is task-33ceae56edc348e9864bc592430fa1d0, which declares dependsOn against this row. The leaf was asked for at 13:42Z and 13:55Z and never filed - that delay is the architect team's, mine included: I noted the gap in a 14:33Z census and did not file it.

THE GAP, measured at HEAD by worker-1d53e70c and re-verified by me:
- `grep -c "preview" apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener-read-dispatch.ts` returns **ZERO**. There are ~25 read routes and not one serves a preview.
- The `preview.decide` offer is a bare envelope (affordance-planning-offers.ts:143-160: commandEnvelopeVersion, commandId, commandKind, expectedVersion, inputSchemaVersion, targetAggregateId). No url, no screenshots.
- `/activity/read` is an exact 7-key shape carrying VERDICTS only - enough for the consumer's DoD 2, nothing for the receipt.
- The runs read carries no preview member.
So the consumer's DoD 1 (render the loopback URL as a link and the captured screenshots inline) is unreachable from the browser today.

THE FACTS EXIST DURABLY AND MUST BE READ, NOT RE-DERIVED. `PreviewReceiptV1` (preview-receipt-contracts.ts:57-68) already carries exactly what the card needs: `url` (string|null), `screenshots` (readonly PreviewScreenshot[]), `outcome` ("REFUSED"|"STARTED"), `code` (PreviewCode|null), plus goalId, sha, pid, receiptId, decidedAt, projectId, version. `readPreviewReceipt` is the production read surface. This row projects and serves; it computes no new authority.

TWO ROUTES, TWO DIFFERENT SHAPES - and the second is why this is a leaf rather than two steps on the consumer:
1. A JSON read serving the receipt for a goalId, exact-key, alongside the other `/*/read` routes.
2. A READ-ONLY CAPTURE ROUTE serving the screenshot BYTES, confined to `.moe-next/previews/<goalId>/<sha>/` (preview-capture.ts:16 documents that layout, and the receipt decoder already validates paths against it).

**ROUTE 2 IS SECURITY-BOUNDARY WORK.** Serving files from disk to a browser needs path-traversal refusal, root confinement, type and size limits. The listener already has that vocabulary - `LISTENER_ASSET_PATH_TRAVERSAL`, `LISTENER_ASSET_OUTSIDE_ROOT`, `LISTENER_ASSET_ROOT_LEAKS_SECRET`, `LISTENER_ASSET_SEGMENT_INVALID`, `LISTENER_ASSET_TOO_LARGE`, `LISTENER_ASSET_TYPE_UNKNOWN` and five more at http-listener-guards.ts:31-41. REUSE that machinery; do not write a second file server. The consumer row could NOT host this: its inherited rail 4 is "FEATURES ONLY: no security-boundary or policy work", and the governor's waiver covered its rail 1 only.

NOT IN SCOPE: the Needs-you card, the approve/reject controls, the status strip, the refusal words, the Playwright journey, the live drive and the docs - all task-33ceae56's.

VERIFICATION COMMAND for moe.complete_task: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`. Also `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` (the proxy roster arm lives there) and `pnpm typecheck`. Root `pnpm test` covers no apps/** file.
definitionOfDone: An authenticated JSON read serves the preview receipt for a goalId: `url`, `screenshots[]`, `outcome` and `code` at minimum, projected from `PreviewReceiptV1` through the production read surface (`readPreviewReceipt`), never re-derived. The response is an EXACT-key shape and a goal with no receipt reads as absent rather than refusing. Assert the served values against a receipt written by the real preview path, not a hand-built one.

A READ-ONLY capture route serves the screenshot bytes and is CONFINED to `.moe-next/previews/<goalId>/<sha>/`. REUSE the listener's existing asset guards (http-listener-guards.ts:31-41) rather than writing a second file server: assert traversal (`..`, absolute paths, encoded separators, a symlink pointing outside the root) is REFUSED with the specific rostered code, and that a path inside the root is served. One arm per refusal class, each asserting the CODE, never merely that it failed.

THE ROUTE SERVES IMAGES AND NOTHING ELSE. A request for a path inside the root that is not a captured screenshot (a `.sqlite`, a `.json`, a dotfile) is REFUSED with its rostered code. The confinement is a directory AND a type: a root-confined server that will hand back any file in the tree is still an exfiltration surface.

Both routes are registered in every seam a read route must appear in and the roster arms pass: the production listener (JSON_ROUTES plus its non-POST guard where applicable), and `apps/control-room/src/live/dev-proxy-paths.ts` with its `live-document-proxy.test.ts` pin. The bidirectional roster arm in `http-listener-read-dispatch.test.ts` must pass without adding an exemption for a route this row serves - if the consumer has not landed yet, record the unconsumed-route census entry NAMING task-33ceae56 as the row that retires it, the way `/repository/bootstrap/read` did.

NO SECRET AND NO HOST PATH LEAKS TO THE BROWSER (epic rail 3). The served JSON carries no absolute filesystem path, no credential and no url with embedded userinfo; the capture route's refusals name a code, never the resolved path they refused. Assert with a positive control so the arm cannot pass vacuously.

MUTATION DRILL, quoted with its failing line: remove the root-confinement check from the capture route and confirm the traversal arm goes RED. Restore per global rail 13 - `git status --porcelain` first, back every mutated path up out of tree, restore FROM THE BACKUP rather than `git checkout --`, and prove by sha256 in a call separate from the restore.

Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`. Root `pnpm test` covers no apps/** file, so say that rather than quoting a bare root count line.
taskRails: SERVE, DO NOT RE-DERIVE. `PreviewReceiptV1` already carries url, screenshots, outcome and code; `readPreviewReceipt` is the production read surface. This row projects them and computes no new authority.

THE CAPTURE ROUTE IS A SECURITY BOUNDARY, NOT A FILE HELPER. Confinement to `.moe-next/previews/<goalId>/<sha>/` is enforced with the listener's EXISTING asset guards; a second file server with its own path logic is the defect this rail exists to prevent.
CONFINEMENT IS A DIRECTORY AND A TYPE. A root-confined server that returns any file under the root is still an exfiltration surface - serve captured images only.
READ-ONLY. Neither route writes, deletes, or creates anything, and neither one starts or stops a preview.
NO UI. The card, the controls, the words and the journey belong to task-33ceae56edc348e9864bc592430fa1d0.

implementationPlan.description:
READ WHAT ALREADY EXISTS BEFORE WRITING ANYTHING. This row reuses more than it builds, and the reuse is the safety property.

(a) THE ELEVEN ASSET GUARDS: read `apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener-guards.ts` around the asset-code block. Record all eleven and what each means - `LISTENER_ASSET_PATH_TRAVERSAL`, `_OUTSIDE_ROOT`, `_SEGMENT_INVALID`, `_ENCODING_INVALID`, `_TYPE_UNKNOWN`, `_TOO_LARGE`, `_NOT_FOUND`, `_READ_FAILED`, `_METHOD_INVALID`, `_ROOT_INVALID`, `_ROOT_LEAKS_SECRET`. Find the static host that ENFORCES them and read how it resolves and confines a path; that function, not a new one, is what the capture route uses.
(b) THE ROUTE ROSTER: `http-listener-read-dispatch.ts:58-68` and `:438`. Note that every `JSON_ROUTES` member must have an EXPLICIT BRANCH or it falls through to the dossier handler - a member added without one is silently mis-served rather than refused.
(c) THE DURABLE FACTS: `preview-receipt-contracts.ts:57-68` `PreviewReceiptV1` and the production `readPreviewReceipt`. Record the exact member names; the JSON route projects these and re-derives nothing (rail 1).
(d) THE UNCONSUMED-ROUTE PRECEDENT: find how `/repository/bootstrap/read` recorded its census entry while its consumer was unlanded. DoD 4 requires the same, naming task-33ceae56edc348e9864bc592430fa1d0.
(e) THE PROXY PIN: `apps/control-room/src/live/dev-proxy-paths.ts` and its `live-document-proxy.test.ts` pin. `/design/read` is NOT pinned there, so confirm the pin is a deliberate act rather than assuming it is automatic.

MINT NO NEW REFUSAL CODE. If you believe you need a twelfth, stop and report - it owes a security-roster row and cardinality pins this row does not own.

THE JSON READ (DoD 1). Create `apps/daemon/src/http/preview-read.ts` (+ a one-line `.js` bridge, the package convention).

An AUTHENTICATED read serving, for a goalId: `url`, `screenshots[]`, `outcome`, `code` at minimum - PROJECTED from `PreviewReceiptV1` through `readPreviewReceipt`, never re-derived (rail 1). Follow `apps/daemon/src/http/design-read.ts` as the shape precedent for a read route module.

EXACT-KEY RESPONSE: an unknown key and a missing key each refuse with the specific code AND the layer that refused. Reuse an already-rostered layer literal; introduce no new `*_LAYER`.

A GOAL WITH NO RECEIPT READS AS ABSENT, NOT AS A REFUSAL (DoD 1). Those are different facts to a card: absent means "no preview yet", refused means "something is wrong". Getting this backwards makes the consumer render an error for the ordinary case.

NO ABSOLUTE FILESYSTEM PATH IN THE RESPONSE (DoD 5, epic rail 3). `PreviewReceiptV1` carries a `pid` and the screenshots live under a real directory - project a RELATIVE reference the capture route can resolve, never the resolved host path. The browser has no use for a host path and every reason not to receive one.

READ-ONLY (rail 4): this module writes nothing, deletes nothing, and neither starts nor stops a preview.

THE CAPTURE ROUTE (DoD 2 and 3) - the security boundary, and the reason this is a leaf row.

Serve the screenshot bytes CONFINED to `.moe-next/previews/<goalId>/<sha>/`, using the listener's EXISTING asset guards (rail 2). Do NOT write a second file server: the eleven codes already distinguish traversal, escape, bad encoding, bad segment, unknown type, oversize, missing and unreadable, and a hand-rolled confinement typically implements four of those and calls itself confined.

CONFINEMENT IS A DIRECTORY **AND** A TYPE (DoD 3, rail 3). A root-confined server that returns any file under the root is still an exfiltration surface - the previews root can sit beside stores, receipts and dotfiles. Serve CAPTURED IMAGES ONLY; anything else inside the root refuses `LISTENER_ASSET_TYPE_UNKNOWN`.
Decide type by CONTENT or by an allowlist of extensions you control - not by trusting the request. Say which in the note.

RESOLVE THEN COMPARE. Confinement is checked on the RESOLVED real path, after symlink resolution, against the resolved root - DoD 2 names a symlink pointing outside the root as its own refusal class, and a check done before resolution passes it.

READ-ONLY and METHOD-GUARDED: a non-GET refuses `LISTENER_ASSET_METHOD_INVALID`. The route creates, writes and deletes nothing (rail 4).

REFUSALS NAME A CODE, NEVER THE RESOLVED PATH (DoD 5). An error that echoes the path it refused hands the caller a filesystem probe - the refusal tells them the class, not the layout.

REGISTER BOTH ROUTES IN EVERY SEAM (DoD 4).

(1) `apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener-read-dispatch.ts` - add the JSON route to `JSON_ROUTES` (:68) AND give it an EXPLICIT BRANCH. The file's comment at :58-63 is the reason: every member either has a branch or IS the dossier path, so a member without one is silently served by the dossier handler. The capture route is not JSON - register it where the asset/static path is dispatched, not in `JSON_ROUTES`.
(2) `apps/control-room/src/live/dev-proxy-paths.ts` - pin BOTH routes, keeping the file's existing ordering, and update the `live-document-proxy.test.ts` pin. Without the pin the dev lane cannot reach either route.

THE BIDIRECTIONAL ROSTER ARM IN `http-listener-read-dispatch.test.ts` MUST PASS WITHOUT AN EXEMPTION for a route this row serves (DoD 4). If it demands one, the branch is missing - fix the branch, never the arm.

THE UNCONSUMED-ROUTE CENSUS: the consumer (task-33ceae56edc348e9864bc592430fa1d0) may not have landed. Record the census entry the way `/repository/bootstrap/read` did, NAMING task-33ceae56 as the row that retires it. A served route with no consumer is a known, named state here - not an accident - and saying so is what stops the next census reading it as dead code.

GATES AND SELF-REVIEW (DoD 7).

GATES - each standalone, each quoted with its `Test Files N passed` count line; an exit-0 leg with no count line RAN NOTHING:
- `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` (@moe/daemon is apps/daemon - resolve by PACKAGE NAME).
- `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` - the proxy pin and its `live-document-proxy.test.ts` live there and no other leg sees them.
- `pnpm typecheck`.
Root `pnpm test` covers no apps/** file - say that rather than quoting a bare root count line.
ALSO consider `pnpm test:security` if anything you wrote resembles a new boundary constant: the security lane scans `^export const ([A-Z0-9_]+(?:LAYERS|LAYER|BOUNDARIES))` and is invisible to both legs above.

SELF-REVIEW, as someone trying to read a file they should not:
- Can ANY input reach a path outside the previews root? Walk each guard in order and name which one stops which input. If two inputs are stopped by the same guard and none by another, one of your arms is not testing what it claims.
- Does the type check run BEFORE or AFTER the confinement check, and does the order matter for what a refusal reveals? A type refusal on an out-of-root path tells the caller the path resolved.
- Is the JSON route authenticated on the same footing as its neighbours? An unauthenticated preview read leaks screenshots of a product under development.
- Does a screenshot filename derived from a goalId or sha ever reach the filesystem unsanitised?
- Did you mint a new refusal code? You should not have - eleven exist.
- Did the roster arm need an exemption? If so the explicit branch is missing.

PATH-ATTRIBUTED BASELINE: merge-base failures, HEAD failures, subtract, intersect with owned paths; complete only when EMPTY. Disclose foreign red verbatim with paths.

planSizeWarnings: Plan touches 7 distinct files (target <=5); plans over 20 are rejected. Small file-disjoint tasks review better and parallelize.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: WRITING A SECOND FILE SERVER for the capture route. Rejected by rail 2 and by measurement - the static host's eleven guards already distinguish traversal, escape, encoding, segment, type, size and read failure, each with its own code because an operator fixes each differently. A second server would either duplicate that reasoning or, more likely, implement four of the eleven and call it confined. MINTING A NEW REFUSAL CODE for "not a screenshot". Rejected - `LISTENER_ASSET_TYPE_UNKNOWN` exists for exactly that, and a new `*_LAYER`/code owes a security-roster row and cardinality pins foreign to this row. SERVING THE SCREENSHOTS AS BASE64 INSIDE THE JSON, avoiding a file route entirely. Considered seriously: it removes the file-serving boundary altogether, which is the riskiest part of the row. REJECTED because captured screenshots are large and a receipt read is polled by a card - inlining them makes every poll carry every image, and the consumer renders them as `` sources. But it is the right instinct, and the mitigation is DoD 3's type confinement: the route serves images and nothing else. ADDING A JSON_ROUTES MEMBER WITHOUT AN EXPLICIT BRANCH. Rejected - `:438` and the dossier fallthrough mean it would silently be handled by the dossier handler rather than refusing. The roster arm catches it; do not add an exemption to quiet it. Size: 8 files, 7 steps.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
MEASURED AT HEAD (moe/work-2026-09-04) by architect-fa3a3e17, 2026-09-06. The row's gap analysis verified, and the area is better provisioned than the description implies - almost everything this row needs already exists and must be REUSED rather than written.

THE GAP IS REAL: `grep -c "preview" apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener-read-dispatch.ts` returns ZERO. No read route serves a preview.

THE ELEVEN ASSET GUARDS ALREADY EXIST and are exactly the refusal roster DoD 2 and 3 ask for. `apps/daemon/src/http/http-listener-guards.ts` carries "The static host's eleven, each naming ONE way a path stops being an asset under the root ... They are separate codes because an operator fixes a misspelled root, a missing file and an attempted escape differently":
  LISTENER_ASSET_ENCODING_INVALID, _METHOD_INVALID, _NOT_FOUND, _OUTSIDE_ROOT, _PATH_TRAVERSAL,
  _READ_FAILED, _ROOT_INVALID, _ROOT_LEAKS_SECRET, _SEGMENT_INVALID, _TOO_LARGE, _TYPE_UNKNOWN
So: traversal -> `_PATH_TRAVERSAL`; escape -> `_OUTSIDE_ROOT`; a non-image inside the root -> `_TYPE_UNKNOWN` (DoD 3's "directory AND type"); and DoD 5's leak concern already has a landed guard - `_ROOT_LEAKS_SECRET` refuses at START when "a servable file carries this daemon's credential or CSRF token". MINT NO NEW CODE. A twelfth would owe a security-roster row and cardinality pins this row does not own, and the eleven were designed for exactly this shape.

THE JSON ROUTE ROSTER IS SELF-CHECKING. `http-listener-read-dispatch.ts:68` `JSON_ROUTES`, with the file's own comment at :58-63: "GUARD ORDER IS THE BEHAVIOUR ... `else serveDocumentDossier(...)` is the roster's own bidirectional consistency - every JSON_ROUTES member either has an explicit branch or IS the dossier path". `:438` `if (!JSON_ROUTES.includes(path))`. So adding a member WITHOUT an explicit branch silently routes it to the dossier handler - the roster arm DoD 4 names is what catches that, and it must pass WITHOUT an exemption.

THE FACTS ARE ALREADY DURABLE (rail 1): `PreviewReceiptV1` (preview-receipt-contracts.ts:57-68) carries url, screenshots[], outcome, code, goalId, sha, pid, receiptId, decidedAt, projectId, version, and `readPreviewReceipt` is the production read surface. This row PROJECTS and SERVES; it computes no authority and re-derives nothing.

THE UNCONSUMED-ROUTE PRECEDENT DoD 4 names is `/repository/bootstrap/read` - find how its census entry is recorded and follow it, naming task-33ceae56edc348e9864bc592430fa1d0 as the row that retires this one's entry.

THE PROXY PIN: `apps/control-room/src/live/dev-proxy-paths.ts` (frozen list) with its `live-document-proxy.test.ts` pin. Note `/design/read` is NOT pinned there, so a pin is not automatic for every route - DoD 4 requires one here deliberately, and without it the dev lane cannot reach either route.
